title: Stop exporting DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS from the agent-loop package root
task:
Problem: packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts:187 re-exports `DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS` (packages/core/agent-loop/src/constants.ts:6) at the package root. Its only consumer outside src is the package's own test (packages/core/agent-loop/tests/tool-calls.spec.ts:14 and :286). Production resolves the default through the Config schema (index.ts:251 and :301) and `resolveMaxParallelToolCalls` (index.ts:134), and the README documents the value as a literal (packages/core/agent-loop/README.md:40, 'default 10; 1 is serial'). The proposed prune note classifies test-only root exports as SDK surface without an owner.

Required: remove the root re-export on index.ts:187; keep constants.ts and every internal use; change tool-calls.spec.ts to assert the documented literal (`toBe(10)`) or to import `../src/constants.ts` (package-local test imports are the existing convention in this repository). No behavior change.

Constraints: do not edit docs/architecture.md (nothing in the loop's behavior changes) and do not touch other exports. Mechanical, local edit under the Agent Note exemption.
